summary: the same class is declared more than once
help: Merge the declarations into one class block.
rationale: Mermaid merges repeated declarations, so the second block is usually copy-paste noise that hides a real difference.

summary: the same method signature is declared twice on one class
rationale: Both copies render, so the class shows a member list the code does not have.

summary: The file does not start with classDiagram
rationale: Detection resolves the kind from the header, so this condition is already reported as common/unknown-diagram-kind.
reason: the kind comes from the header in the kinds table, so a missing or unknown header is common/unknown-diagram-kind

summary: The relationship operator is invalid, for example ->
rationale: The class grammar knows a fixed set of operators, and an unknown one cannot express a relationship.

summary: The relationship line is incomplete, with a missing target or invalid label syntax
rationale: A relationship with no target or a broken label renders nothing or misparses.

summary: A class X { block is not closed with }
rationale: Every line after the open brace is read as a member, so the rest of the diagram misparses.

summary: A member line is malformed, with a missing name or tokens in the wrong order
rationale: Members are parsed positionally, so a malformed line silently drops the member.

summary: A double-quoted class name or label contains an inner "
rationale: The inner quote ends the name early and corrupts the rest of the line.
